<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 700" width="600" height="700">
  <!-- White background -->
  <rect width="600" height="700" fill="#ffffff" />

  <!-- Base platform -->
  <rect x="150" y="550" width="300" height="20" fill="#f0f0f0" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" />
  <line x1="170" y1="570" x2="190" y2="590" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <line x1="200" y1="570" x2="220" y2="590" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <line x1="230" y1="570" x2="250" y2="590" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <line x1="350" y1="570" x2="370" y2="590" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <line x1="380" y1="570" x2="400" y2="590" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <line x1="410" y1="570" x2="430" y2="590" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" />

  <!-- Bell jar -->
  <path d="M 230 550 
           C 230 450, 240 220, 300 160 
           C 360 220, 370 450, 370 550 Z" 
        fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2.5" />
  
  <!-- Narrow neck of the bell jar at the top -->
  <path d="M 290 160 L 290 120 M 310 160 L 310 120" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2.5" />

  <!-- Side pipe B from the bell jar -->
  <path d="M 238 480 L 170 480" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2.5" />
  <path d="M 170 470 L 140 480 L 170 490 Z" fill="#000000" />

  <!-- Mercury dish/trough inside the bell jar -->
  <rect x="260" y="500" width="80" height="50" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" />
  <!-- Mercury in dish -->
  <path d="M 262 515 Q 300 510 338 515 L 338 548 L 262 548 Z" fill="#b0b0b0" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" />

  <!-- Glass tube (100 cm long) -->
  <rect x="292" y="120" width="16" height="410" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" />

  <!-- Mercury inside the tube (up to 760 mm level) -->
  <rect x="294" y="240" width="12" height="290" fill="#b0b0b0" />

  <!-- Point Y at the bottom of the tube inside the mercury -->
  <circle cx="300" cy="525" r="3" fill="#000000" />
  <text x="325" y="530" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-style="italic">Y</text>

  <!-- Vacuum pump connection tube at the top A -->
  <path d="M 292 120 L 292 90 L 400 90" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" />
  <circle cx="300" cy="120" r="2" fill="#000000" />
  <text x="275" y="110" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-style="italic">A</text>

  <!-- Dashed level lines -->
  <line x1="230" y1="515" x2="280" y2="515" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="5,3" />
  <line x1="320" y1="240" x2="380" y2="240" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="5,3" />

  <!-- Double-headed arrow for 760 mm -->
  <line x1="360" y1="240" x2="360" y2="515" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <polygon points="360,235 356,245 364,245" fill="#000000" />
  <polygon points="360,520 356,510 364,510" fill="#000000" />
  <text x="375" y="385" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16">760 mm</text>

  <!-- Labels and pointers -->
  <!-- Bell jar label -->
  <line x1="355" y1="350" x2="450" y2="350" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" />
  <text x="460" y="355" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16">bell jar</text>

  <!-- Mercury label -->
  <line x1="335" y1="535" x2="450" y2="535" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" />
  <text x="460" y="540" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16">mercury</text>

  <!-- Glass tube 100 cm long label -->
  <line x1="310" y1="180" x2="450" y2="180" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" />
  <text x="460" y="185" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16">glass tube 100 cm long</text>

  <!-- To vacuum pump label -->
  <line x1="370" y1="90" x2="450" y2="90" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" />
  <text x="460" y="95" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16">to vacuum pump</text>

  <!-- B label -->
  <text x="140" y="465" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-style="italic">B</text>
  <line x1="145" y1="470" x2="160" y2="475" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" />

  <!-- Caption -->
  <text x="270" y="640" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16">Fig. 6.1</text>
</svg>
